config.op-devtools.compileAndDeploy.exam: Run command. Operator name, execution mode and package mode are appended automatically.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.showQuickOp: When enabled, choosing **Sanitizer** in **Actions** opens the quick options panel; start the run from the panel. When disabled, the sanitizer runs immediately from the tree.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.memory.mark: Base: illegal read/write, multi-core stomp, unaligned access, illegal free.
Optional memory check item (effective when Memory is enabled).
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.allocUnused: Optional memory check item (effective when Memory is enabled).
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.maxSingleLo: Max single log file size. Integer `1-10240`, unit `MB`. Default `1024`.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.detectionSc: Detection scope (`global` or `singleBlock`). Integer `0-200`. Before enable: memory/init/sync detect all blocks; race: inter-core all blocks, intra-core block `0`. After enable: memory/init/sync detect specified block; race: no inter-core, specified block intra-core.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.enableMsAge: Enable msAgent AI fix for sanitizer (experimental)

When enabled, and the **msAgent** extension is installed, the sanitizer sidebar can offer **AI fix** actions and the latest sanitizer log is loaded into msAgent automatically after a successful run. When disabled or msAgent is missing, those controls stay hidden. msAgent is not bundled; install it separately until it is published to the Marketplace.
config.op-devtools.performanceTuning.sim: When enabled, choosing **Simulation analysis** in **Actions** opens the quick options panel; start the run from the panel. When disabled, simulation runs immediately from the tree.
Simulator type. See supported types under CANN path `ascend-toolkit/latest/tools/simulator`.
Default: compute & move unit instruction time ratio.
Parameters are appended to command line. Run `msprof op -h` for options. `aic-metrics` is set in base config. Parameter name has `--` prefix by default.
config.op-devtools.performanceTuning.onB: When enabled, choosing **On-board analysis** in **Actions** opens the quick options panel; start the run from the panel. When disabled, on-board analysis runs immediately from the tree.
Checking this collects all operator performance metrics by default.
Checking this collects all operator performance metrics by default.
Checking this enables all operator metrics. Unchecking this disables all operator metrics.

Enable kernel code-segment profiling. For custom range, call [MetricsProfStart](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/83RC1/API/ascendcopapi/atlasascendc_api_07_1214.html) and [MetricsProfStop](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/83RC1/API/ascendcopapi/atlasascendc_api_07_1215.html) in kernel code. Confirm you have called both around the kernel code segment; otherwise this option has no effect.
Parameters are appended to command line. Run `msprof op -h` for options. `aic-metrics` is set in base config. Parameter name has `--` prefix by default.
config.op-devtools.environment.environme: Environment script. Absolute path to `set_env.sh` after CANN install. Empty if using one-stop platform image. If path error appears, set a valid env script path.
config.op-devtools.environment.socVersio: SoC version for project commands (for example: `ascend910b`, `ascend10b`, `ascend950`).
